copy_gaps: Two wordings for one state: `14` L682 'Trading for this symbol is paused by the exchange' (the state row's quote, L406) and E08's delisted chip 'Delisted by the exchange' (E12-D02 L318; E08-D04 L48), which E08 uses for a pause too (E08-D01 L21: removed or paused). Both are drawn: the word as the marker, the sentence as its description. E11-D04 C-15 / A-4 (L930, L989; the `14` owner) would point SCR-030's string at SCR-047's deck; once it lands the description's text is E18-D05's with E08's owner.

The sentence's home: L406 quotes it without a slot, E12-D02 L575-576 rules out a strip line and D2 L152 adds no row, so it is drawn as the marker's description, E11-D02's status-chip pattern (L654, L667: aria-describedby and a tooltip on focus); the moment drawn is keyboard focus on the marker (constant FOCUSED). At rest the sentence is in the DOM only. Carries proposed for §5 L406 and §0 L79 (board Notes).

The last bar's time: E12-D02 L318 names it and gives no words or slot (its board 36 draws a placeholder beside the chip); drawn as the bare bar time '13:35' beside the marker, unlabelled. Its form (for example E11-D02 D16's ' · last <time>' suffix, L123) is E18-D05's to write.

Enter on the marker: E11-D02 L667 opens a chip's details (SCR-153 for the feed chip); no target is given for the delisted marker (E11-D04 L345's 'Open symbol info' → SCR-103 belongs to the empty case).

Policy gap, not copy (the Announcement block): E08-D04 L48 gives delisted no live-region behaviour, while CMP-239's panel rule (`15` L2771) and E08-D01 L70-71 announce a panel's entry into a degraded state once, politely; E11-D02 §10 has no delisted row (L424). The annotation states the polite reading and flags E08-D04's; the policy is E18-D04's table (§8.2 L750) with E08's owner.
Bar times 12:50-13:20: §4.1 names only 13:25, 13:30 and 13:35 (L225-227); the older bars are the kit's 5-minute steps back from 13:35 (bar_times), as boards 02-06, 20, 28 and 30.

deviations: The cells as last received are board 28's streaming frame (board 20's two placements, as boards 28 and 30): the window 63,975.0-64,014.0 and 13:35 with only §4.1's five levels, the cells it held when the exchange paused the symbol, so the frame reads as board 28 without the cap. The 64,014.0 row, where board 28's cap draws, stays empty; with no cap, 13:35's high ledge sits 2 px above 64,013.0 (D6 L156: beyond the cap only at a forming high). The bars' 63,974.0 row lies below the window, cut by clip_to_view(). Still 40 rows of 17.6 px (§3 L185).

The delisted marker's home: E12-D02 L318 names the state, not its slot; it is drawn in E11-D02's feed-chip position, first after the env badge (L422), because E08's precedence puts delisted above every feed state and one state shows, never stacked (E08-D01 L30, L117; E08-D04 L50; `15` L2769).

The marker is composed: a 20 px outlined pill (radius.badge, 8 px padding, the 1 px light hairline: E08-D04 L48's ambient surface, no fill), an 8 px ink dot (E11-D04 L478 'the delisted word + dot'; the indicator's hue is E18-D03's) and the words in type.ui.caption. The words are not struck through: E08's strike-through marks the delisted value (E08-D01 L86; E08-D04's 'sample value'), and E12-D02's board 36 draws the chip unstruck.

The CMP-016 tooltip is composed in the kit's tooltip look (raised fill, 1 px hairline, popover elevation, radius.control; CMP-016's color.surface.overlay is not one of the board's greys), 24 px high, 4 px under the status row, left-aligned with the marker at an estimated x.

The countdown reads 'closed', CMP-226's state for a market pause (E11-D02 L332), in the middle grey; the readout 'last 64,011.0 · spread 0.1' stays as last received (no source changes it); the time strip's cluster keeps 'auto' pressed (the latest bar is in view).

The sentence's slot and the moment drawn are the board's reading, not the state row's: §5 L406 quotes `14`'s sentence without a slot and §0 L79 names no moment, so the frame shows the marker focused with the sentence as its description (E11-D02 L654, L667). Proposed carries for the boards PR (named in the Notes block): (1) §5 L406, the fp-paused row's 'What the footprint layer shows' cell: '"Trading for this symbol is paused by the exchange" (`14`); with history, E08's CMP-239 `delisted` state (E12-D02 §8); cells kept as last received; no forming cap and no new cells' → '"Trading for this symbol is paused by the exchange" (`14`), the marker's description (E11-D02 L654; `15` L192: `aria-describedby`, a tooltip on hover and focus); with history, E08's CMP-239 `delisted` state (E12-D02 §8) in the feed chip's place (E11-D02 L422), beside the last bar's time; cells kept as last received; no forming cap and no new cells; the countdown reads "closed" (E11-D02 §7.4)'; (2) §0 L79, board 37's frame cell: '`SCR-030/fp-paused`' → '`SCR-030/fp-paused` (the marker focused, its description open)'.

Local helpers in gen_37.py (e18kit lacks them; e18kit.py not edited): pin_all(), LOCAL and CARRIES (the cited lines, E08's word and the carries' current text at their lines), build_scene() and clip_to_view() (as gen_20.py / gen_28.py / gen_30.py), dot(), delisted_marker(), focus_ring(), status_row(), marker_x(), description_tooltip(), panel_rows() (k.panel() takes no ColGeo and draws its own status row), the checks and the .md writer.
The base scene's 40 rows span 63,974.0-64,013.0: the top row is the forming bar's high as §4.1 draws it (L219-220, the cap above 64,013.0); §3 L192-194 fixes 40 rows of 1.0 USDT but no prices.

Candle bodies of generator bars are bars.mjs's open and close (same seed) scaled into the 40-row window; every bar spans the window (§3 L193: every row traded), so the wick runs top to bottom; the body is filled (its form is E12-D06's, §4.1 D3).
Edge levels (no neighbour inside the bar) are not compared: `24` §4.2's treat_as_min would flag every bar's high (sell) and low (buy); the §4.1 anatomy draws no such flag (L220-224).

Kit geometry for marks the spec sizes only in part: POC rails 1 px on the level's top and bottom edges across the candle strip and the cells; VA ticks 2 px thick (6 px long, D6) at VAH's top edge and VAL's bottom edge; bracket end ticks as thick as the bracket; the cap spans the cells; folded columns draw brackets and VA ticks over the cells' outer edge (D4).
An imbalance outline is two rects: a 1.5 px ink frame (§4.4 L282: a token stroke is 1 or 2 px) and an inner rect in the cell's background; the digits draw over both.
D6's 'bold digits' at the POC are not drawn: no bold mono type token exists at 10 / 11 px (type.num.xs / .sm are regular); the rails carry the POC on the boards (hi-fi: E18-D03).
A mark beyond the plot (the forming cap 1 px + 2 px above a column whose top is the window's top, an unfinished-auction ledge at the window's edge) is not drawn: §3's 40 rows fill the pane exactly.
A stack's zone state is server-told (GAP-18, §4.4 L288-289); the kit draws 'active' (3 px) unless the board names another state.
The legend row and the corner badge sit on a raised fill so they read over the cells.

Price labels sit at E11-D02 §5's density gap (40 / 48 / 32 px) on whole-price steps; a label wider than §3's 48 / 56 px gutter floor (L177) extends left into the plot's free margin (memo §3.0: the bar counts are upper bounds).
Every control, chip, button, field, menu, tooltip, drawer and dialog is a composition named '<CMP id> <Name> (composition)': the wireframes are greys only and cvsheet v1 cannot recolour an instance.

The marker's focus ring is an outer 2 px color.focus.ring stroke on a wrapper hugging the 20 px pill, so the ring spans the 24 px status row exactly and the row does not move; CMP-039's 2 px offset is hi-fi's (E11-D02 L652 gives chip buttons 2 px of invisible padding above and below: a 24 px hit box).

Frames are named as §0 names them ('SCR-030/fp-anatomy'), and cvsheet splits section paths on '/', so frame() names the node with U+2215 '∕' for '/' while sections address inside it; the live renderer renames each frame to its §0 name after the board's last section (live check).
